meta.title: ULAB Undergraduate Summer 2026 — Complete Semester Plan
meta.description: Consolidated day-by-day reference combining the Academic Calendar, weekly recurring Class Schedule, and Midterm Exam Schedule for Summer 2026 (Undergraduate), across all departments (BUS, BLL, CSE, EEE, ENG, MAT, MSJ, GEF, HUM, NSC, PHY, SSC, SCM, STA, UCC, ECO, ESK, ELL, ESS, ME, CHEM, GED, etc.).
how_to_read: academic_calendar: One-time semester milestones — orientation, registration deadlines, payment deadlines, holidays, exam windows, last class days, result publication, next-term start.

weekly_recurring_class_schedule: The standing weekly timetable. Regular (non-lab) courses meet twice a week as a fixed pair — Sunday+Tuesday OR Monday+Wednesday. Lab/blended sessions may meet only once a week; when a course entry carries a single-day tag (e.g. '(S)','(T)','(M)','(W)') it means that particular section meets ONLY on that one day, not on both days of its block pair. Thursday and Saturday were added as a newer slot alongside existing LAB classes and ESK/ELL/GEF sessions.
midterm_exam_schedule: Specific calendar dates (28 June - 4 July 2026) for the midterm exams, organized the same way as the class grid but tied to exact dates instead of a recurring weekly pattern.

faculty_legend: Every faculty initials code used in either schedule, decoded to full name. Two source legends (class schedule and exam schedule) were merged; a small number of codes only appear in one of the two files.
faculty_research_areas: From the separate CSE Faculty Research Area Mapping graphic. This is a placeholder pending more images the user plans to add.
'TBA' means the room or faculty had not yet been finalized in the source spreadsheet.

notes_and_caveats: Source spreadsheets contain minor inconsistent spacing/typos in course codes (e.g. stray dashes, missing spaces before dashes); the 'raw_text' field is preserved for every entry so nothing is lost even where the code splitter guessed imperfectly.
Some faculty codes in the raw sheets do not appear in either legend table (unlisted); these are marked as '<CODE> (unlisted)' in faculty_names.
Course codes combine a short subject code (e.g. CSE 2201) with a long numeric registrar code (e.g. 0613-014-2201) where the sheet provided both; some entries only had one or the other.

The class-schedule legend and exam-schedule legend differ slightly in a handful of codes (e.g. different spellings/typo variants for the same person); both variants are kept as separate legend keys to stay faithful to the source.
